ApiToken.description: An API token (the secret is only returned once, by `POST /api-tokens`).

prefix.description: The first characters of the token, e.g. `rrmm_pat_Ab3d…`.

sanitized.description: The SVG was changed by sanitising (elements or attributes removed).

file_id.description: A branding file id, or `null` to remove the logo.

allowed_cidrs.description: Source networks (`203.0.113.0/24`, `2001:db8::1`); omit for any address.

client_ids.description: Restrict to these clients; omit or `null` for your full scope.

expires_at.description: Defaults to 90 days from now; at most one year.

permissions.description: A non-empty subset of your own permissions.

token.description: The token itself, shown only in this response.

secret.description: Only present when the server generated the secret.

editable.description: Whether the caller may edit it.

is_default.description: Whether this is the caller's Home dashboard.

widgets.description: Widget names a layout may use.

digest_valid.description: PE only: the Authenticode digest matches the file's contents.

timestamped.description: Authenticode: a countersignature or RFC 3161 timestamp is present.

LastDelivery.description: The last delivery outcome shown on a webhook.

status.description:
`signed` (every file) | `partially_signed` | `unsigned` | `invalid` (a signature does not
match its file) | `unknown`.

client_secret.description: Write-only. Omit on update to keep the stored secret; `""` clears it (public clients).

trust_unverified_email.description: Accept the `email` claim without `email_verified: true` (e.g. Entra ID).

ProviderDto.description: A provider as the API shows it (`client_secret` is write-only).

has_client_secret.description: Whether a client secret is stored (the secret itself is never returned).

redirect_uri.description: The redirect URI to register at the identity provider.

PublicBranding.description: Public branding for the login page and console title.

enforced.description: Password sign-in is reserved for owners (break glass).

Report.description: A rendered report: what the console shows and what CSV/PDF are built from.

ReportParams.description: Report parameters (every type takes the first four; the rest are type-specific).

actor.description: `audit`: actor id or part of the actor name.

client_id.description: A client id, or `"all"`/omitted for every client you can see.

emailed_to.description: Addresses a scheduled run was e-mailed to (JSON array).

permission.description: The view permission the report's data needs (besides `reports.view`).

group.description: Group value from the group claim (exact, case-sensitive).

async.description: Queue the run (`202 { run_id }`) even when it is small.

duration_minutes.description: Window length; defaults to the policy window's duration (15–1440).

per_client.description: One branded report per client, sent to that client's primary contacts plus `recipients`.

run_ids.description: The runs created (one per client with `per_client`).

Section.description: One block of a report. `kind` selects the shape.

oneOf.description: `chart`: `bar` | `line` | `donut`. Each series has one value per label.
Plain text (paragraphs separated by blank lines; no markup).

thumbprint_sha1.description: SHA-1 of the signer certificate (upper-case hex), as Windows shows it.

source.description:
`release` (newest imported release), `distribution` (agent distribution directory, no
release imported yet) or `none`.

enforce.description: Blocks password sign-in for everyone except global owners (break glass).

has_secret.description: The signing secret is write-only; this is always true.

secret.description: Write-only. Generated (and returned once) when omitted on create; omit on update to keep it.

events.description: Event names a webhook can subscribe to.

info.description: REST API of the RustRMM server. Authenticate with the console session cookie (plus `X-CSRF-Token` on mutations) or with `Authorization: Bearer rrmm_pat_…` (API tokens; no CSRF token; step-up actions, shells and desktops are refused). Errors use `{ "error": { "code", "message", "details" } }`. Results are scoped to the caller.
info.title: RustRMM API
